description: Configure publishing as the page owner or space admin. publish_to_update initially publishes the current version; readers then keep seeing the published version while editors draft. live immediately exposes the latest draft. reviewerUids replaces the reviewer list; omitting it clears reviewers. Only call when the person asked to change these settings.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_set_page_publishing
title: Set page publishing
